import pandas as pd, numpy as np
df = pd.read_csv('daily_cost_4.csv')
# For each series, compute z-score using median/MAD and also compare to neighbors
rows=[]
for (acc,svc), g in df.groupby(['SubAccountName','ServiceName']):
    g = g.sort_values('ChargePeriodStart')
    v = g['BilledCost'].values
    med = np.median(v)
    mad = np.median(np.abs(v-med)) or 1e-9
    z = 0.6745*(v-med)/mad
    for i,(idx,row) in enumerate(g.iterrows()):
        rows.append((row['ChargePeriodStart'],acc,svc,row['BilledCost'],z[i]))
res = pd.DataFrame(rows, columns=['date','acc','svc','cost','z'])
print(res.nlargest(8,'z'))

tool_calls.code:
import pandas as pd, numpy as np
df = pd.read_csv('daily_cost_4.csv')
rows=[]
for (acc,svc), g in df.groupby(['SubAccountName','ServiceName']):
    g = g.sort_values('ChargePeriodStart').reset_index(drop=True)
    v = g['BilledCost'].values
    for i in range(1,len(g)-1):
        # local baseline: median of all other points
        others = np.delete(v,i)
        base = np.median(others)
        dev = v[i]-base
        rows.append((dev, g['ChargePeriodStart'][i], acc, svc, v[i], base))
res = pd.DataFrame(rows, columns=['dev','date','acc','svc','cost','base']).sort_values('dev',ascending=False)
print(res.head(10))

{"code": "import pandas as pd, numpy as np
df = pd.read_csv('daily_cost_4.csv')
# For each series, leave-one-out robust z (median/MAD of the rest)
rows=[]
for (acc,svc), g in df.groupby(['SubAccountName','ServiceName']):
    v = g.sort_values('ChargePeriodStart')['BilledCost'].values
    d = g.sort_values('ChargePeriodStart')['ChargePeriodStart'].values
    for i in range(len(v)):
        others = np.delete(v,i)
        med = np.median(others); mad = np.median(np.abs(others-med)) or 1e-9
        z = 0.6745*(v[i]-med)/mad
        rows.append((z, d[i], acc, svc, v[i]))
res = pd.DataFrame(rows, columns=['z','date','acc','svc','cost']).sort_values('z',ascending=False)
print(res.head(6))"}
